items.title: Final Testing Before v1.0
items.content: TotemBound is now in final testing ahead of our v1.0 launch. We're polishing the last details and squashing bugs — see what's landed and what's still ahead on the roadmap.

items.title: All 12 Mystical Species Now Available
items.content: Raven and Snake have arrived — the full menagerie of 12 mystical species is now ready to raise. Hatch the complete roster across all five stages and rarities.

items.title: Traits Shape Every Totem
items.content: Every totem now carries up to three traits — one at birth, one chosen as it matures, one unlocked at ascension. Each has a real effect that changes how it performs in challenges, expeditions, and daily care.

items.title: Daily Quests Are Here
items.content: Five themed quest slots refresh every day — feed, train, challenge, or expedition. Finish them all to unlock a bonus pile of Essence plus a random Rune.

items.title: Keeper's Village Hub Opens
items.content: A panoramic spirit village is now your home base. Tap any building to enter — Sanctuary, Bazaar, Shrine, Forge, Elder Tower, Library, Hall of Legends, Arena, Trailhead, Hearthstone — all reachable from one immersive view.

items.title: Elder Sanctum & Totem Forge Are Live
items.content: Seat your Stage 4+ totems in the Elder Sanctum for passive Essence and solo advisory missions. Fuse three same-rarity totems in the Forge to ascend to the next tier — Pure or Wild Fusion modes available.

items.title: Expeditions & Challenges Are Live!
items.content: Send 3-totem teams on 15 expeditions across Earth, Water & Air domains. Tackle 10 skill-based challenge mini-games to earn XP, happiness, and Essence rewards.

items.title: Guided Tutorial & Achievement System
items.content: New players can follow a 6-step guided tutorial with reward claims at each milestone. Plus, track your progress across 25+ achievements as you grow your collection.

items.title: Join Our Discord Community
items.content: Connect with other Totem Keepers, get tips, and participate in exclusive events!

items.title: Welcome to TotemBound Beta!
items.content: Explore the world of spiritual companions and start your journey as a Totem Keeper. Raise, train, and evolve 12 mystical species across 5 stages.
